description: This file defines the SeoTransform class, which is a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation used to convert URLs into SEO-friendly formats within a web application. It includes methods for processing URL parameters, applying regex-based URL rewriting patterns, and integrating with the web request/response environment to generate transformed URLs.
external_methods: RequestHandler.makeLink(request, response, url, fullPath, secure, encode)

classes.name: SeoTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class that converts URLs into SEO-optimized formats using regex patterns and environment-aware URL generation.

methods.name: checkArg
methods.description: Checks whether a given argument in a map is set to true or false, based on string comparison, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes and potentially transforms URL strings during template rendering, integrating with the web environment to generate correct URLs.

methods.name: seoUrl
methods.description: Transforms a URL into an SEO-friendly version based on a set of regex patterns, considering anonymous user access and session identifiers.
